notes: This file is the canonical seed dataset for Cherokee vocabulary in this project.
Romanized pronunciations are source-provided learner spellings, not strict phonemic transcriptions.
IPA is intentionally left null until each entry is reviewed against a stronger pronunciation source.
Where sources disagree, the primary form keeps the pronunciation-bearing source and alternate spellings are preserved in alternates.
